text.body:
Advayavajra's works
3. Mūlāpatti
edited by MM Hara Prasad Shastri {\S}
in Advayavajrasaṃgraha GOS 1927 Baroda
edited by Mikkyou-seiten-kenkyūkai {\M} 1.
in Taisho Daigaku Sougou Bukkyou Kenkyūjo Nenpou 10
Annual of The Institute for Comprehensive Studies of Buddhism
Taisho University 10, 1988, pp.(42/193)
^\S p.13.
^\M 42/193
% \msT (Tōkyō colour ms.) [12\recto3']
% \msN (NGMPP B 22/24) [8\recto3']
apratiṣṭhitanirvāṇaṃ jagadānandasundaram |
natvā mañjuśriyaṃ vakṣye mūlāpattīś caturdaśa || 1 ||
% vakṣye \M] vakṣāt \S, vakṣe \msN
ācāryeṣv avamānena sugatājñāvilaṅghane |
dveṣād gotraguṇākhyāne mahāmaitrīvivarjane || 2 ||
% IEB 323 ``the message of the Tathāgata''
% dveṣād] \M\msN, dviṣṭa \S, gātra- \msT
% bhrātraguṇākhyāne \msN (IEB: gotragaṇa) [?] p. 323: ``anger at members of the feast family''
bodhicittaparityāge yānatritayanindane |
guhyākhyāne jane pakṣe jinātmaskandhadūṣaṇe || 3 ||
% jane 'pakṣe \msT, \& (IEB 323) ``revealing secrets to unprepared people'', jane| pakṣe \msN
% ibid. ``Disparaging the Victor's body of instruction.''
% ˚dūṣane \msT\msN
śuddhātmadharmasandehe duṣṭamaitrīvirāgataḥ |
dharmeṣv anadvayārope śrāddhacittapradūṣaṇe || 4 ||
% duṣṭa \M\msN (also \msT \& IEB)] iṣṭa \S
% ˚maitryacirāgataḥ \msT
% śrārddha[\msT 12\verso]
samayāsevane 'prāptau prajñātmastrīpradūṣaṇe |
mūlāpattir bhavet tena mantriṇaḥ samayakṣatiḥ || 5 ||
% āsevane \M] āśevane \S\msT\msN
% 'prāptau \M] prāptau \S\msT (or prāpto?) \msN (IEB 323: ``Not relying on the sacraments and vows.'' ``Disparaging insight-filled women.'')
% mūlāpatti[\msN8\verso]
% kṣatiḥ \M\msN] kṛtiḥ \S
tatkṛtau siddhayo na syur māro duḥkhasya sañcayaḥ |
nirayagatiṃ ca bhuṅkte 'sau tīvrāṃ vividhavedanām || 6 ||
% syuḥ \msN
% nirayagatīñ ca \msT, tirayagatīñ ca \msN
% sau \msN
% tīvrāṃ ... vedanām \M] tīvrā vedanāḥ \S, tīvrā vividhavedanāḥ \msN
guror yathāptitaḥ pūjāṃ vidhāya maṇḍale tataḥ |
% yathā'ptitaḥ \msT\msN
gṛhṇīyād bodhicittaṃ ca ratnatrayādisaṃvaram || 7 ||
mūlāpattayaḥ samāptāḥ || ||
% samāptaḥ || || [\msT12\verso3] [\msN8\verso2']
% Davidson IEB p. 414: A corrupt version of the Sanskrit of this list is found in the \textit{Mūlāpattayaḥ Sthūlāpattayaḥ} in the \textit{Advayavajrasaṃgraha}, Shastri 1927, p. 13; among the many problems in the text, gotraguṇa (l. 5) should read gotragaṇa, jane pakṣe (l. 7) should be jane 'pakṣe, and iṣṭa- (l. 8) should be duṣṭa.
I have relied of [!] the various short texts covering these twenty-two, collectively To. 2478--2488, especially the \textit{Vajrayānamūlāpattiṭīkā--mārgapradīpa}, To. 2488, of Mañjuśrīkīrti.
